name: Cantore's Pizza
tagline: Hand-tossed pies, dough made fresh every day. Dine in, take out or delivery in West Lebanon, NH.
seo_title: Cantore's Pizza | Hand-Tossed Pizza in West Lebanon, NH
seo_desc: Cantore's Pizza, 1 Glen Road Plaza Suite 14, West Lebanon NH. Fresh dough made daily, calzones, stromboli, subs and salads. Dine in, take out or delivery. Call 603-298-7775.
about: After many years of working and eating all over New England, Cantore's Pizza has opened here in the Upper Valley. Vinnie Cantore's family is from the area. Vinnie's father is one of the original owners of the Dirt Cowboy Café in Hanover, NH, and Vinnie has lived most of his life in the Upper Valley.

Our pies are hand tossed and our dough is made fresh on premise every day. We use only the highest quality cheese; our mozzarella contains buffalo milk, delivering a creamy, delicious, melted topping. One of Vinnie's biggest fans is his brother, Jim Cantore of The Weather Channel.
extras: Gluten free pizza, offered in 12" pies from a local NH 100% gluten free bakery.
Daiya vegan cheese as a gourmet topping on any of our pizzas.
Beer and wine available when dining in.
specials: Tuesdays all day: 2 large cheese pies for $26
Wings Wednesdays: free fountain soda plus $3 off XL or $1 off 8 wings
Lasagna Thursdays: free fountain soda plus $2 off your order
delivery: Delivering to Lebanon and surrounding areas. Delivery orders taken right up to closing time; $5.00 delivery charge. Orders $100 or more include 10% gratuity; orders $300 or more include 20% gratuity.
